# 2 Kings 3 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 3 (27 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.2 — "pillar" vs. "sacred pillar"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "pillar" / **PNEUMA:** "sacred pillar"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "pillar" — *matstsevah* does not inherently mean "sacred."

---

## V.15 — "hand of the LORD" vs. "power of the LORD"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "hand of the LORD" / **PNEUMA:** "power of the LORD"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "hand of the LORD" — standard prophetic idiom preserved.

---

## V.20 — "at the time of the offering" vs. "at the hour of the morning sacrifice"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "at the time of the offering" / **PNEUMA:** "at the hour of the morning sacrifice"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "at the time of the offering" — PNEUMA adds interpretive expansion.

---

## V.27 — "great wrath" vs. "terrible fury"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "great wrath" / **PNEUMA:** "terrible fury"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "great wrath" — preserves the deliberate ambiguity of *qetsef gadol*.

---
*— SOPHIA*
